svg.title: Telemetry collection, visualization and investigation boundaries
svg.desc: AKS managed Prometheus metrics go to Azure Monitor Workspace (AMW). Container Insights logs and inventory go to Log Analytics (LAW). Managed Grafana visualizes both. Gateway signals and LAW feed Azure Monitor alert rules and the configured action group approved receiver. Agent reads use a separately scoped identity and authorized LAW and resource metadata tools; native incident intake is conditional on independent configuration and testing, not established by receiver delivery.
